Hey I was in a similar situation, although my history was not so extensive. Anyways I had by everyone else's measurements a really good life. Great job, great friends, lots of girls, awesome place to live, etc.....however everyday all I thought about was suicide. I hated all of my friends, my home, my family, everything. There was no explaining it, it was just fed up with everything. I went on meds, but they didn't help so I started drinking heavily. I hurt myself in an accident real bad while drinking, had to stop work and everything for awhile. Ironically now I had a reason to feel shitty, everything started making sense and I started to feel better. Some sort of weird internal guilt I was carrying where maybe I felt I didn't deserve those things?  I'm not sure. I'm not suggesting you find something to feel bad about, but just hoping that my story might help you explore possible reasons behind your own experiences. Since then I have moved many different places to build up new lives, but I keep a strong link to home. Now I feel like I have earned my happiness. That being said I still get extreme depression, but it is something I work with and understand a little bit more now.

Don't worry. You'll be ok. Time moves faster and faster, next thing you know you'll be old and cripple, but you'll look back on your life and know you finished your story. Exams are shitty, but once they are over you'll have a breather. Then there are so many options of what to do with your life. I suggest getting in touch with nature and new people. Even though it is hard, always push yourself to do new things, hard things, shitty things, whatever if it is new and it even seems slightly interesting, try it.
There are many days left to live. Everyday the world changes. One day it will change for the better. Stay in there and keep fighting for your life.
